scope_predicate: Three architectural anomalies in SGW.exe CME EventSignal subsystem: BM callback mechanism, GiveInventory anomaly, VSGWHomeless purpose

anomalies.resolution: BM emitters use Pattern B (cme-event-signal.md). Not a third mechanism. scalable_malloc(0xC) + typed ctor + SetField x N + vtable slot 2 dispatch via thunk_FUN_0054c900 singleton. All 4 emitters confirmed: 0x00e59970, 0x00e59c70, 0x00e59da0, 0x00e59f70.

Event_NetOut_GiveInventory is a server-only GM tool signal. TypedEmitInfo exists (0x00d97830) but no client-side subscriber was ever registered — no CallbackImpl. The actual GiveInventory player path is Event_SlashCmd_GiveInventory which has full CallbackImpl (0x00c964d0) and SGWTextCommandMgr binding (0x00c9a2a0). register_NetOut_GiveInventory (0x00d97750) has zero callers — only a DATA xref at 0x019cad68 (vtable entry).

VSGWHomeless is the SGWHomeless class — a single-instance in-editor developer tool manager. RTTI confirms class name 'class_SGWHomeless'. Not a catch-all; it is a specific subsystem for editor-mode event handling. Registers 22 Editor_* subscriptions via FUN_00d3efb0. Ends by calling FUN_0057b800('editor') to register as the editor mode. Some handlers open ShellExecuteW URLs (dev placeholders). Singleton at DAT_01ef2380, init-once at DAT_01ef23f8. W5-C checkpoint addresses 0x00d3daXX were mid-function addresses inside SGWPIEScriptManager helpers — not SGWHomeless function entry points.

open_questions: Option_* subscriptions for SGWHomeless (ChatFontSize, UIScale, GamepadEnabled, etc.) not located — must be in a second registration function not yet found. Low priority (client-only).
DAT_019bc634 — unresolved string label used by FUN_00d3eba0 SGWHomeless handler. Low priority.
FUN_0057b800 / FUN_0057d070 — CME mode registration calls at end of FUN_00d3efb0. Contract not yet documented.
